findings: learner.overview: It presents the uncertain grain interpretation as the entry’s main explanation but leaves out the better-supported early use evidence and the overlap between 少 and 小. Lead with the reported early uses for “few” and “small” and say their spellings overlapped; retain the grain reading only as a qualified proposal if useful. Cite X-3e7c7db97d01891137c7, X-8487cd1cb9ca11b26969, and X-4f12b8722fda0ada6672.

meaning_history.senses[0].status and meaning_history.senses[1].status: Both early senses are labeled earliest_attested, but the cited evidence reports early spellings used for both meanings and does not establish either as the earliest attested sense. Set both statuses to historical while retaining the supported early-use claims and established certainty. Cite X-3e7c7db97d01891137c7 and X-8487cd1cb9ca11b26969.

meaning_history.senses[0].period and meaning_history.senses[1].period: “Oracle-bone and bronze inscription usage reported” overstates the cited support for both senses: the evidence specifically reports oracle-bone forms for “few” or “small,” while bronze examples also include “few” and sometimes “small.” Make the periods sense-specific—for example, “Oracle-bone and bronze usage reported” for “few” and “Oracle-bone usage reported; some bronze examples also use 少 for 小” for “small.” Cite X-3e7c7db97d01891137c7, X-8487cd1cb9ca11b26969, and X-4f12b8722fda0ada6672.
